create_writer_write_examples: create a Writer instance to shuffle and write serialized examples to sharded TFRecord files
create_beamwriter_write_pcollection: create a BeamWriter instance to shuffle and write Apache Beam PCollection examples to sharded record files
build_shard_specs_from_config: build shard specifications from example count, total size, bucket lengths, and shard configuration
write_index_file_for_shard: write an index JSON file mapping record positions for a given shard path
finalize_writer_return_shard_lengths: finalize a Writer to flush all buffered examples and return shard lengths and total size
